repsim.setup_note: checkpoint load + get_dataset + dataset construction, NOT included in wall_s -- same convention as InfluCoder/Semantic so all three wall_s values bracket compute only

semantic.setup_note: get_dataset + encoder load, NOT included in wall_s -- excluded to match InfluCoder's inference-only wall_s convention (Semantic is InfluCoder's untrained-encoder control doing identical embed+score work)

influcoder.setup_note: one-time cost (get_dataset + pool building + teacher-grad extraction + encoder load + distillation), NOT included in wall_s; reported as cost-from-scratch even when the teacher gradients were served from cache
influcoder.config_note: lr lowered 5e-5 -> 2e-5 and hard_ratio 0.5 -> 0.25 after a sweep: identical-config reruns at the old setting spread 0.075 AUPRC on Het, vs 0.018 here. Reported value is a single run (rep2 of 3), not a mean. Observed 3-rep spread: Counterfact 0.000 (bit-identical), Het 0.041, Hom 0.021.
